verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents validating cases against a given jurisdiction, filing them, and tracking filings through FinCEN. Narrative templates and case file attachments support building the report from case evidence. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the SAR form-preparation workflow itself (field population from case evidence), evidence of jurisdictions beyond FinCEN, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can prepare a jurisdiction-specific suspicious-activity report from case evidence
